title: ReservationMade
description: Booking oprettet: a member got a seat on a class session, directly or from the waitlist. Published by Booking, consumed by Notification (docs/domain/CONTEXT-MAP.md section 5). The message carries the correlation ID in its X-Correlation-ID header, not in the body.

reservationId.description: The reservation's id in Booking. Consumers use it to handle the same event only once.

classSessionId.description: The id of the class session the seat is on.

memberId.description: The member who got the seat (MemberId, from Membership).

startTime.description: When the class session starts, ISO 8601 with an offset.
